Question 15
?

From top to bottom, what are the missing expressions in the following polynomial division problem?

4x+6x2−2x+34x+64x3−2x2+10x+184x+64x3+6x2―4x+64x3−8x2+10x+184x+64x3−8x2−12x―4x+64x3−8x2−12x+184x+64x3−8x2−12x+18―4x+64x3−8x2+48x−10

a
x2−4x+6 and 8x2−15x
b
x2−8x+5 and −6x2−4x
c
x2−6x+3 and −6x2−8x
d
x2+4x+4 and 8x2−10x
e
x2−2x+3 and −8x2−12x
